title: REEF Marine Education & Conservation Internship (Spring 2027 Cohort)
description: A 3-to-5-month, in-person internship with the Reef Environmental Education Foundation (REEF), a marine conservation nonprofit based in Key Largo, Florida, in the heart of the Florida Keys. Interns work from REEF's campus supporting citizen science, community outreach, and education programs, and gain hands-on experience in partnership development, nonprofit operations, donor relations, communications, data management, and event planning; REEF has run this internship since 1993. REEF provides housing for interns plus a $400/month stipend (through the REEF Oceans for All Fund); flights and meals are not covered. This is the Spring 2027 cohort, running January 5 through May 22, 2027. One letter of recommendation is required as part of the application. Details cross-referenced against REEF's own site description and independent internship listings (UCLA Career Center, SEVENSEAS Media) that converge on the same deadline and stipend.
visaNote: This is a domestic US-based internship; non-US applicants would need to independently arrange their own visa/work-authorization status to intern in the United States.
